outcome.name: CONTINUOUS_ROUTE_REQUIRES_DECLARED_CROSSINGS
outcome.rationale: A coherent forward→aft carrier exists: the ventral keel bar already runs under KEEP_COCKPIT and under the can. No empty spine. No existing holes in the three bulkhead plates. Continuity along that carrier therefore requires a declared crossing at each of BULKHEAD_Z3.35, BULKHEAD_Z1.15, and BULKHEAD_Z-1.70 — ideally sleeves at the already-overlapping keel/plate intersections. Edge-wraps in unmarked interstitial are not treated as granted passages. This does not authorize cutting.
